celebrates: Cranberry Township sits in Butler County north of Pittsburgh, and its Christmas season spreads across several hosts. Fun Fore All Family Fun Park turns its two mini golf courses into a holiday lights outing on most evenings, according to the park. The township runs a sensory friendly Santa drive thru at the Municipal Center for children who find crowds hard. Neighboring towns add to the list: Mars Area Public Library holds a Nutcracker program for kids, Zelienople lights up Main Street on a December evening, and Enchanted Lights in Freedom offers an evening walk of lights.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap for these events, so this page relies on each host's own 2026 listing. facts: Fun Fore All Family Fun Park lists separate pricing for one or both courses and lets children age two and under play free with a paid adult. Enchanted Lights lists children under three as free and charges for parking. The Zelienople event takes place on Main Street, and the county tourism calendar lists it as free. The Cranberry Township Municipal Center is the site for the township's sensory friendly Santa drive thru.
